projects.name: Campus in a rack (senior project)
projects.description: Built a three-building campus network using six real Cisco 2960 and 3560 switches and three ISR routers, configured via console. Segmented students, staff, and security cameras into separate broadcast domains connected through a distribution layer. Subnetted a /22 block into allocations for 11 departments with documented records. Configured a link-state routing protocol in a single backbone area and verified failover convergence under 10 seconds. Produced topology diagrams and a port-by-port cabling sheet still used by the lab.

projects.name: Guest Wi-Fi for the college open day
projects.description: Set up two access points with a separate visitor network and selected non-overlapping channels using a phone-based Wi-Fi analyser.

projects.name: Why is Lab 3 slow?
projects.description: Captured traffic on the lab uplink using packet analysis tools, identified a PC flooding the segment with broadcast frames due to a faulty network card, and disabled its port until replacement.
